# Afternoon Plumbing LLC

> Afternoon Plumbing LLC is an owner-operated residential plumbing business based in Westminster, Maryland, focused on water heaters, well pump problems, water treatment equipment, and everyday residential repair work.

Afternoon Plumbing LLC serves homeowners across Carroll, Baltimore, Frederick, and Howard County, generally within about 20 miles of Westminster. Estimates are free, the full quote is provided upfront before work starts, and labor carries a 1 year warranty. Maryland State Licensed Master Plumber #17734. Fully insured.

Phone: 443-789-2897. Email: afternoonplumbingcc@gmail.com. Base: Westminster, MD 21157.

Core services include water heater replacement and installation, heat pump and hybrid water heater installation, gas water heater installation, well pump repair and replacement, water softener, filtration, acid neutralizer, and whole house water treatment, sump pump replacement, frost free hose bib replacement, seasonal winterization, house side gas appliance hookups, gas line repairs, and regulator replacement, leak diagnostics, and faucet, valve, and fixture work.

## Water heater services

- [Water heater replacement](https://afternoonplumbing.com/services/water-heater-replacement-westminster-md.html): Leaking tanks, no hot water, and replacement options including tank, tankless, gas, and electric units.
- [Heat pump water heater installation](https://afternoonplumbing.com/services/heat-pump-water-heater-installation-westminster-md.html): Hybrid and heat pump tank units, with guidance on fit and condensate setup.
- [Gas water heater installation](https://afternoonplumbing.com/services/gas-water-heater-installation-westminster-md.html): Gas water heater replacement and installation for Westminster and nearby towns.

## Well pumps and water treatment

- [Well pumps overview](https://afternoonplumbing.com/services/well-pumps.html): Hub for well system work, including no water calls, pressure issues, and pressure tanks.
- [Well pump repair and replacement](https://afternoonplumbing.com/services/well-pump-repair-westminster-md.html): Troubleshooting, repair versus replacement decisions, and full pump replacement.
- [Water softener installation](https://afternoonplumbing.com/services/water-softener-installation-westminster-md.html): Hard water testing and right sized softener installs for well water homes.
- [Water treatment system replacement](https://afternoonplumbing.com/services/water-treatment-replacement-westminster-md.html): Replacing aging softeners, filters, and neutralizers, or swapping a full whole house treatment system.
- [Acid neutralizer installation](https://afternoonplumbing.com/services/acid-neutralizer-installation-westminster-md.html): Low pH well water treatment that protects copper lines, fixtures, and appliances.

## Exterior, seasonal, and everyday repair

- [Hose bib replacement](https://afternoonplumbing.com/services/hose-bib-replacement-westminster-md.html): Frost free hose bib and outdoor faucet replacement.
- [Winterization](https://afternoonplumbing.com/services/winterization-westminster-md.html): Seasonal check of hose bibs, water heaters, well systems, treatment equipment, and gas appliances before the first hard freeze.
- [Sump pump replacement](https://afternoonplumbing.com/services/sump-pump-replacement-westminster-md.html): Failing sump pumps, constant running, noisy cycling, and battery backup options.

## Gas work

- [Gas appliance hookups](https://afternoonplumbing.com/services/gas-appliance-hookups.html): House side regulator replacement, gas appliance hookups, and house side gas line leak repairs.
- [Gas leak safety](https://afternoonplumbing.com/services/gas-leak-safety-westminster-md.html): What to do and who to call if a gas smell is suspected.
- [Regulator replacement](https://afternoonplumbing.com/services/regulator-replacement-westminster-md.html): Propane and natural gas regulator replacement on the house side of the meter.
